title: The Momentum Map
thesis: Turn mid-career noise and drift into one named, realistic next move.
visualMetaphor: A gold route becomes clearer as experience is translated into a choice and a 90-day goal.

beats.purpose: Acknowledge accumulated experience and reduced clarity.
beats.visual: Completed-work markers behind a figure; branching route ahead.
Thought fragments converge toward an empty page.
A drifting path straightens through pause, reassess, choose, and a 90-day marker.
One route divides into promotion, lateral move, and role redesign.
Three route cards show scope, fit, and reshaping.

beats.purpose: Frame the choice around personal fit.
beats.visual: Values, energy, and life constraints overlap.

beats.purpose: Resolve drift into a named next move.
beats.visual: A 90-day goal anchors a sequence of small compounding steps.
